objectClass.note: Flat vector construction, not a photographed volume. The single reference view is a complete description of the silhouette; there is no hidden side to infer.

identityDefiningFeatures: rounded-corner play triangle that opens at the top vertex
interlocking monoline strokes reading as R / E / F counterforms
arrow tip inside the right-hand vertex
detached horizontal bar at lower centre-right
constant stroke width across the whole construction

silhouetteIoU.method: tools/verify_trace.py, rasterised polygons vs thresholded reference mask

acceptance.residualError: antialias fringe of the source PNG; invariant under further contour refinement (0.9 → 0.2 px RDP sweep held IoU at 0.971–0.973)

statedApproximations: Extrusion depth and bevel radius are art direction, not measurements — the source is a 2D mark with no depth to recover.
Material is authored to match the reference hero render's finish, not physically measured.

topology.note: The background is a single connected region: every interior white area drains to the outside through a stroke gap, so the mark needs no hole contours.

strokeWidth.method: 2 × p95 of the Euclidean distance transform over the ink mask

componentDecomposition.method: Zhang-Suen thinning → junction-cluster cut → direction-continuity re-chaining → nearest-skeleton pixel partition
componentDecomposition.rationale: The reference hero render shows one continuous bevelled solid; per-stroke meshes would put bevel seams mid-stroke. The decomposition is kept as intake evidence and as the basis for any future per-stroke animation.

componentHierarchy.name: rupe-logo
componentHierarchy.role: root, externally transformable and directly manipulable

build.space: model space, Y-up, origin at the mark bbox centre, height = 1, aspect 0.99613
build.geometry: THREE.Shape → ExtrudeGeometry, depth 0.115, bevelSize/Thickness 0.0105, 4 bevel segments, toCreasedNormals at 34°
build.bevelSafety: bevel is 15% of the 0.0695 stroke width, well clear of self-intersection at the tightest concave junctions

materials.environment: procedural 512×256 equirect studio (canvas) → PMREM: white ceiling, narrow horizon strip for the bevel highlight, two softbox strips, violet floor bounce
materials.evidence: reference hero render sampled at p20 #391473 / median #6534a9 / p80 #9870d4

key.why: point falloff paints the tonal gradient the reference shows across the flat front face

pivotsAndAnchors.rootPivot: mark bbox centre, on the extrusion mid-plane

restPose.why: three-quarter view matching the reference hero render

interaction.idle: 0.16 Hz + 0.043 Hz detuned sines (bounded, never a linear creep) plus a 0.55 Hz float — faded down as the visitor's own angle takes over
interaction.drag: pointer-driven yaw/pitch; a container width of travel sweeps ~1.4π. Touch drives yaw only, so the page keeps its vertical scroll (canvas is touch-action: pan-y)
interaction.limits: yaw unbounded — full 360° spin in either direction; pitch ±1.0 rad absolute as a rubber band (0.28 resistance outside, spring back at λ 5) to stay clear of Euler gimbal
interaction.momentum: flick velocity decays at 1.4/s; pitch momentum dies on contact with its limit
interaction.return: holds the visitor's angle while the pointer is still over the mark, then settles at λ 0.45 after 2.6 s idle onto the NEAREST WHOLE TURN, so spun turns are not rewound; the settled turn is then folded out of the accumulated angle
interaction.keyboard: focusable stage; arrows rotate (0.16 rad, 0.42 with Shift), Home/Escape resets
interaction.pointerParallax: damped lean toward the cursor, weight fades to 0 during a drag and back in over ~0.5 s
interaction.scroll: damped 0…1 hero progress → yaw −0.3, pitch +0.14, push +0.9 z, drop −0.34 y, scale +5%
interaction.reducedMotion: no idle, parallax or momentum; drag still works and the mark keeps the angle it is left at, loop parked between interactions

optimization.offscreen: IntersectionObserver pauses the loop, visibilitychange pauses on tab hide
optimization.lite: 2 bevel segments, antialias off, 2 lights instead of 4
optimization.loading: three.js dynamically imported after first paint
optimization.teardown: geometries, material, env render target, renderer disposed + forceContextLoss
